title: VP of Product
description:
EnterpriseCore Systems is a $150M ARR enterprise software company. We're hiring a VP of Product to lead our 12-person product organization and set the strategic direction for our core platform.

This role requires:
- 12+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years in senior leadership
- Director or VP-level experience managing product managers (team of 5+)
- Experience owning product strategy for a product line with $50M+ ARR
- Demonstrated ability to drive enterprise sales-assisted GTM motions
- P&L or budget ownership experience
- Board-level presentation experience
- Deep enterprise software background — you've worked with Fortune 500 buyers

Responsibilities:
- Own the product vision and roadmap for all product lines
- Manage and grow the product management org (currently 12 PMs)
- Partner with Chief Revenue Officer on product-market fit and pricing strategy
- Present roadmap and strategy to the board quarterly
- Own vendor relationships and partner integrations
- Drive pricing strategy and packaging decisions with Finance

This is a highly strategic, cross-functional leadership role. We need someone who has navigated complex enterprise procurement cycles and managed large product organizations. Not suitable for ICs or those without substantial leadership experience.

Comp: $280k-$330k base + equity + bonus
